chapters.title: Chapter 1: The Two Kinds of Change
Chapter 2: Do We Take Progress for Granted?

episode.tagline: How do we bring about change? How should we think about changing the state, changing society, changing ourselves?
episode.about: In this episode, Ajay and Amit discuss discuss theories of change in different contexts, with one common theme: we need to play the long game.
